title: Rocky Jordan
paragraphs: An atmospheric crime-adventure series set in Cairo, where American café owner Rocky Jordan operates the Café Tambourine and repeatedly becomes entangled in murder, espionage, and international intrigue.
Adventure/crime series about American cafe owner Rocky Jordan. Frozen GRH container also preserves two 1945 precursor broadcasts and 1951/1955 audition recordings.

GRH documents the program through A Man Named Jordan precursor (January 8, 1945 to April 20, 1947) on [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]], Rocky Jordan CBS West Coast (October 31, 1948 to September 10, 1950) on [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]], and George Raft CBS network revival (June 27, 1951 to August 22, 1951) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].
